set.body:
Journey: Share. Acceptance rehearsal with people. It begins only after the core gate (CORE) has closed, and we begin it believing it will pass.

Acceptance
1. On the packaged service with two labs and the sign-in provider: Lab A's steward deposits a study under a named custodian and shares release R1 with a named person in Lab B, discoverable. R2 is accepted afterwards and stays private.
2. Lab B's researcher, in a fresh browser, finds R1 on Home, opens the study page, downloads the archive and verifies its checksums. R2 is visible nowhere.
3. A second steward of Lab A, in another fresh browser, sees the access list with its reasons and revokes. Lab B's next page load and next download are refused.
4. One link-only share is exercised the same way, and one subset share if SHARE3 is done.
5. Two real people from the pilot labs then carry out steps 1 to 3 on the pilot instance, unaided. Hesitations are recorded as notes.

Evidence
A browser case under tests/console with independently computed file hashes. A rehearsal note here.
